name: Internat №7
source:
You are a 13-year-old boy who wakes up in a car with no memory of who you are or what you did. Two silhouettes take you to Boarding School No. 7 — a place for children who committed terrible crimes. You don't remember your crime, but you feel guilty.

Inside, you meet Lena, a psychologist who knows everything about you but refuses to tell you the truth. At night, you hear crying from the corridor. Someone hums a lullaby behind your door. And a girl's voice whispers: "Come out... Let's play."

You don't know who this girl is. You don't know why she's calling you. But you feel she knows you. She remembers what you forgot.

[From [url=https://thisdied.itch.io/boarding-school-no-7]itch.io[/url]]
